# SAVED_REPLIES

LightSpeedWP canonical “saved replies” for GitHub Issues/PRs.

> **Storage model**
>
> - **Org‑wide canonical:** `lightspeedwp/.github/.github/SAVED_REPLIES.md` with per‑reply files in `lightspeedwp/.github/.github/SAVED_REPLIES/`.
> - **Per‑repo override/additions:** `<repo>/.github/SAVED_REPLIES.md` and `<repo>/.github/SAVED_REPLIES/*.md`.
>
> Copy/paste snippets into **GitHub → Settings → Saved replies** (GitHub has no official API).

## Contents
- Needs more information — `SAVED_REPLIES/issues-needs-more-info.md`
- Reproduction request — `SAVED_REPLIES/issues-needs-repro.md`
- Duplicate of #{issue} — `SAVED_REPLIES/issues-duplicate.md`
- Considered – out of scope (for now) — `SAVED_REPLIES/issues-out-of-scope.md`
- Security disclosure process — `SAVED_REPLIES/issues-security-disclosure.md`
- Thanks – quick tidy-ups — `SAVED_REPLIES/prs-thanks-nits.md`
- Request changes – tests needed — `SAVED_REPLIES/prs-request-tests.md`
- Fix WPCS/PHPCS findings — `SAVED_REPLIES/prs-phpcs-wpcs.md`
- Add i18n wrappers + translator comments — `SAVED_REPLIES/prs-i18n.md`
- Add docs + changelog + version bump — `SAVED_REPLIES/prs-docs-changelog-version.md`
- Performance check before merge — `SAVED_REPLIES/prs-performance-check.md`
- Community standards reminder — `SAVED_REPLIES/support-coc-reminder.md`
- Block attributes & validation — `SAVED_REPLIES/wp-block-attributes-validation.md`
- Theme – use theme.json — `SAVED_REPLIES/wp-theme-themejson-guidance.md`
- Closing pending feedback — `SAVED_REPLIES/maintenance-close-stale.md`

## Using placeholders
Replace placeholders before posting: `{repo}`, `{issue}`, `{pr}`, `{version}`, `{file}`.
